description: Closelooknet’s Ratio Chart presets: relative-performance facts for ten pairs — India vs US (Nifty 50 / S&P 500, INDA / SPY), EM vs US (EEM / SPY), developed ex-US vs US (EFA / SPY), Japan vs US (Nikkei / S&P), growth without tech (QQXT / QQQ), health care vs tech (XLV / XLK), low-vol vs momentum (SPLV / SPMO), gold vs US equities (GLD / SPY), bitcoin vs S&P 500. Per pair: current ratio, 1y change, all-time low/high with dates, percentile in its own history, distance from the low, lowest-since date. Weekly since each pair’s first common date. Mirrors closelook.net/lab/ratio/ (where any pair can be charted).
